priorities.finding: Only request_context shows positive training-only primary lift (+0.00221) with full coverage. The evidence supports prioritizing it for within-user ranking, but the daily lift is variable and exceeds zero mainly on three of four days, so confirm before expanding budget. GAUC is stronger for cold users (0.654) and warm users/items (0.631) than the corresponding nDCG@5 values (0.492 and 0.508), indicating ranking discrimination without a clear top-five improvement.
priorities.recommended_action: Advance request_context to the next validation stage with a small budget and retain early stopping; require confirmation of primary lift and separately monitor GAUC and nDCG@5.

metric_diagnosis: Apply the strict early stop after the single positive screened group: all other screened groups have negative primary lift, with especially large and consistent losses for historical_author_response and historical_item_response. Do not treat the cold-item results as reliable segment evidence because they contain only 8 rows and remain at the baseline values (GAUC 0.5, nDCG@5 0.25). The available diagnostics show GAUC strength does not automatically translate into top-five strength, so both metrics must be tracked. Current-impression outcomes are leakage and must remain excluded; aggregate video statistics without per-impression availability timestamps must remain quarantined.
